holderQuote: One of Rabbiteater’s new Skills made it so that everything he held became stronger, more durable.
effectQuote: made it so that everything he held became stronger, more durable

holderQuote: Rabbiteater sat up. He blinked and looked down at his body. He stared at his worn chainmail shirt and slightly dented sword as they began to glow. Rabbiteater saw the chainmail straighten, shed the rust, and take on a smooth, almost silky sheen. He drew his sword and saw it glow as the blade became straight, the edge razor-sharp. He looked around and waved his arms. All the other Goblins were asleep. So Rabbiteater took a deep breath and shouted.
He had walked out there trusting to a few Skills.
